THE FIRST RULE FOR YOU IS TO KEEP IN MIND THE FLOW OF APP AND MAKE READY TO PUBLISH BUT BUILD COMPLETE,YOU WILL WORK ALSO ON ITS BACKEND(FOLDER gigmatch).THE APP YOU WILL BUILD IS Gigmatch
Core features:
1. Artist/Band Profiles
2. Upload music samples, videos, and photos.
3. Bio section with genre, influences, and contact info.
4. Availability calendar for gigs.
5. Ratings and reviews from verified bookings.
6. Venue & Event Organizer Profiles
7. Ability to post gig opportunities (date, time, budget, genre preference).
8. Search and filter bands by genre, location, price range.
9. Swipe-based discovery (Tinder-style) for quick browsing. 
10. Matching System
11. Swipe Right: Save band to favourites or initiate contact.
12. Swipe Left: Skip band.
13. Smart recommendations based on genre, location, and past bookings.
14. Booking & Communication
15. Direct messaging or integrated chat.
16. Option for phone number in bio for quick calls.
17. Reviews & Reputation
18. Only verified bookers can leave reviews.
19. Reputation score for artists based on reliability, performance quality, and audience feedback. 
20. Monetization Model
21. Subscription for Artists: Monthly or yearly fee for profile visibility.
22. Premium Features:
23. Boosted visibility in search/swipe.
24. Analytics (profile views, engagement). 
25. Venue Side: Free entry to attract adoption.
26. User Experience Flow
27. Artists:
Sign up → Create profile → Upload samples → Set availability.
28. Venues:
Sign up → Browse bands → Swipe → Contact → Book.
29. Discovery:
Tinder-like interface for quick browsing.
Advanced filters for serious searches.
30. Extra Features for Growth
30.1 Genre Segmentation: Rock, Jazz, Indie, Hip-Hop, etc.
30.2 Location-Based Matching: Bands within X miles.
30.3 Push Notifications: New gig opportunities, messages.
30.4 Community Features: Tips for artists, networking forums.
